bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test -f scripts/userbot_topic_audit_client.py || exit 71
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 72
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 73
python3 scripts/userbot_topic_audit_client.py --chat-id -1002373696859 --topic-id 1605 >/tmp/video-topic-userbot-audit.out 2>/tmp/video-topic-userbot-audit.err || exit 74
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,sys
p=pathlib.Path('/tmp/video-topic-userbot-audit.out').read_text()
line=next((x for x in p.splitlines() if x.startswith('USERBOT_TOPIC_AUDIT=')),None)
if not line:sys.exit(75)
d=json.loads(line.split('=',1)[1])
rows=d.get('rows') or []
if d.get('status')!='PASS' or len(rows)!=1 or rows[0].get('topic_id')!=1605:sys.exit(76)
r=rows[0]
if r.get('pin_state')!='PRESENT' or 'normal' not in r.get('button_types',[]):sys.exit(77)
if 'INTERNAL_CALLBACK' not in r.get('pin_transports',[]):sys.exit(78)
print('VIDEO_TOPIC_USERBOT_PIN_BUTTON=PASS')
PY
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 79
